First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 12+ mph: you can talk the whole way. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Thursday Fun Ride group ride

Thursday Fun Ride is a road group ride in Prescott Valley, AZ. It rolls every Thursday at 9:00 am from Viewpoint Park, Prescott Valley (the Oct 1 start; it changes with the route).

Bike Prescott’s easy Thursday road ride, built for less experienced riders and anyone who wants a gentler day. Most rides are under 20 miles and as flat as the area allows, and the group rides at the pace of the slowest rider. The Oct 1 ride is 18.2 miles out and back on Coyote Springs Rd from Viewpoint Park, with an option to add 10 miles.
